## 2. Deep-Dive Solution Architectures

### 2.1 Custom Enterprise ERP & Multi-Warehouse Inventory Systems
URL: https://mtechsolutions.online/erp-software

M-Tech Solutions designs custom Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) platforms tailored to high-volume wholesale distributors, retail chains, and manufacturing/import businesses:
- **Multi-Branch & Multi-Warehouse Stock Control:** Real-time inter-branch stock transfers with state-machine lifecycle tracking (`Draft` → `Dispatched` → `In-Transit` → `Received` / `Discrepancy Flagged`).
- **Landed Cost & True Margin Engine:** Automatically apportions international freight, customs duties, clearing charges, packaging, and local transport across incoming Purchase Orders (PO) and Goods Received Notes (GRN) to compute exact unit landed cost and live net profit margins.
- **Double-Entry Supplier & Customer Ledgers (AP/AR):** Tracks credit limits, partial invoice settlements, post-dated checks, credit notes, Returned Merchandise Authorizations (RMA), and 30/60/90-day balance aging reports.
- **Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) & Audit Trails:** Granular permission guards for Owners, Branch Managers, Cashiers, Warehouse Staff, and Sales Hunters, backed by immutable activity logs.

### 2.2 Offline-First Mobile & Desktop Point of Sale (POS)
URL: https://mtechsolutions.online/pos-system

Engineered for environments where internet connectivity can fluctuate or drop completely:
- **Local-First Persistence Layer:** Full product catalog, barcode indices, customer balances, and tax rules are cached locally in IndexedDB (Web/PWA) or SQLite (React Native / Electron / Desktop).
- **Zero-Downtime Offline Billing:** Cashiers can scan 1D/2D barcodes, apply wholesale tier discounts, split tender payments (Cash, Card, Bank Transfer, Credit Account), and print thermal receipts in < 50ms with zero internet connection.
- **Deterministic Conflict Resolution & Background Sync:** Queued offline invoices are stamped with cryptographic UUIDs and vector timestamps, syncing automatically via background workers as soon as network connectivity resumes without duplicate deductions.
- **Turnkey Hardware Bridging:**
  - **Thermal Receipt Printers:** 80mm and 58mm ESC/POS printers via WebUSB, Web Bluetooth, raw TCP/IP network sockets, and Windows/macOS serial print spoolers.
  - **Barcode & QR Scanners:** Continuous HID USB laser scanners, wireless 2.4GHz warehouse scanners, and mobile camera barcode recognition.
  - **Cash Drawers & Label Printers:** RJ11/RJ12 pulse-triggered cash drawers and Zebra/TSC barcode sticker printers.

### 2.3 Mobile Parts & Electronics Wholesale ERP SaaS
URL: https://mtechsolutions.online/erp-software

A specialized vertical ERP engineered by M-Tech Solutions specifically for smartphone spare parts importers, LCD/IC wholesalers, and repair centers:
- **Component Taxonomy:** Structured hierarchy for Mobile LCDs/OLEDs (Original Service Pack, OLED, Incell, TFT), IC Chips (Power IC, Charging IC, Audio IC, Baseband, CPU/NAND), Flex Cables, Batteries, Housings, and Micro-Soldering Tools.
- **Cross-Model Compatibility Matrix:** Maps interchangeable spare parts across multiple phone brands and model generations so counter staff immediately see compatible alternatives in stock.
- **IMEI, Serial & Batch Warranty Tracking:** Tracks individual serial/batch barcodes to prevent fraudulent RMA returns and monitor supplier defect rates by batch.
- **Multi-Tier B2B Wholesale Pricing:** Supports Retail Walk-In, Technician Price, Wholesale Tier 1, Wholesale Tier 2, and VIP Partner pricing automatically at checkout.

### 2.4 Learning Management Systems (LMS) & Computer-Based Testing (CBT) Portals
URL: https://mtechsolutions.online/portfolio

Proven in live academic production with **Cadets Coaching Academy** and the **CCA Examination & Testing Portal**:
- **High-Concurrency CBT Exam Engine:** Supports 15,000+ simultaneous student sessions, randomized MCQ question banks (750+ curated questions per stream), server-synchronized countdown timers, anti-tab-switch proctoring alerts, and instant automated scorecards.
- **Academic & Pre-Commissioning Tracks:** Built for FBISE/Punjab Board Classes 1–10 and military/cadet college entrance preparation (PAF College Sargodha, Military College Jhelum/Murree/Sui).
- **Faculty Command Center:** Real-time student cohort management, attendance, fee voucher generation, and subject-wise performance telemetry.

### 2.5 Headless E-Commerce & High-Speed Web Applications
URL: https://mtechsolutions.online/services

- **Frontend Stack:** React 19, Next.js (SSR/SSG/ISR), Vite 8, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS 4, GSAP ScrollTrigger, Framer Motion.
- **Backend & Database Stack:** Node.js, Express, Firebase (Firestore, Realtime Database, Authentication, Cloud Functions, Global CDN Hosting), PostgreSQL, MongoDB (compound indexing & sub-100ms aggregation pipelines), Shopify Storefront GraphQL API.
